title: Cardinal preservation, forcing iterations and Boolean completions
planned_consuming_entries: **Preserving cardinals**; **Cardinals in Cohen extensions**; **Iterated forcing**; **Martin's axiom**
existing_coverage_and_exact_fact: [Finite partial maps](entries/pressing-down-and-delta-systems/entry.html#finite-partial-maps) prove that two binary maps have a common extension exactly when they agree on their overlap. The [uncountable compatible-family theorem](entries/pressing-down-and-delta-systems/entry.html#uncountable-compatible-family), using the [delta-system lemma](entries/pressing-down-and-delta-systems/entry.html#delta-system-lemma), gives an uncountable pairwise compatible subfamily.
remaining_scope_to_develop: Develop ccc and Knaster preservation, cardinal calculations for Cohen forcing, relevant iteration theorems and their applications, including Martin's axiom. A Boolean-algebra presentation additionally needs Boolean completions. Equality of ordinals in a generic extension alone does not establish cardinal preservation or a CH independence witness.
